WINBACK_STANDARD.name: Standard Win-Back
WINBACK_STANDARD.description: Re-engage dormant customers with a bounded discount offer.
WINBACK_STANDARD.notes: Base amount is the campaign offer value, not derived from customer AOV.

WINBACK_HIGH_VALUE.name: High-Value Win-Back
WINBACK_HIGH_VALUE.description: Premium re-engagement for historically high-value dormant customers.
WINBACK_HIGH_VALUE.notes: Higher offer value for customers with demonstrated lifetime spend.

NURTURE_STANDARD.name: Standard Nurture
NURTURE_STANDARD.description: Nurture offer for active customers showing declining engagement.
NURTURE_STANDARD.notes: Lower offer value; these customers are still active.
